parameters.description:
Relay an SMS through your own Octopush account by posting a native Octopush payload to the UnitySVC gateway.

`octopush-sms-relay` accepts an HTTP POST with a native `octopush_sms` payload. The gateway composes the upstream Octopush URL from your stored secrets, injects your credential header, and forwards the request, so your credentials never leave the platform.

Two channels are available: the free `byok` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `plus` channel binds an extra per-enrollment credential via enrollment parameters.

api_key_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's API key
